message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine charges based on facts. The facts: Wang 1 (王1某) provided false guarantee to help a company get loan 5 million, defaulted, causing loss 6.852 million. Also as legal person of another company, provided false loan extension documents to get loan 21 million, later repaid. So that's fraud to obtain loans: "骗取贷款罪" (loan fraud). Also there is a second person Guo (郭某栋) who helped Guo1 (郭1某) hide, drive, etc. The charge is "窝藏罪" (concealing a criminal). The prosecution says Wang1 also did that? Actually the text: "第二、窝藏罪 ... 郭某栋明知郭1某涉嫌犯罪的情况下，仍负责给其开车...". So the second charge is for Guo (郭某栋). But the prosecution says "王1某...帮助其逃匿". Actually they mention "且明知是犯罪的人而为其提供隐藏的处所、财物，帮助其逃匿". So they attribute to Wang1 as well? The text: "且明知是犯罪的人而为其提供隐藏的处所、财物，帮助其逃匿". That seems to refer to Wang1? But earlier they described Guo's actions. Might be both. However the charge list: "骗取贷款罪、窝藏罪". So answer should list both.

Thus final answer: [罪名]骗取贷款罪;窝藏罪<eoa>
